clue.text: She arranges to preen herself before everyone gets back

indicators.note: before places the first piece ahead of the second in the answer
arranges says the letters of 'to preen' are set out in a new order
gets back says the word for everyone is turned round and read from its end

parts.note: everyone means all

explanation.surface: A vain woman preens herself in the mirror before everybody returns home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranges' turns TO PREEN into PETRONE; 'gets back' turns ALL into LLA. 'herself' is padding for the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Petronella is a woman's given name, so it can stand for any female person.
